title: Controller owned workspace lifecycle summary
description: Read-only task.workspaceLifecycle in GET /api/state. Derived from the current controller private flows, never task metadata or a saved journal. Null means no current owned flow, not evidence that cold-restart secret files or locks were cleaned. No permit, flow ID, run ID, credential, secret path or raw error is returned. idle：Hub owned 程序已退出、MCP 與目的地同意已撤銷，lease 保留至多 10 分鐘；下次由使用者送出時完整重新驗證，失敗則釋放並要求重新核准。

retryClose.description: UI may offer the existing authenticated close route; this value grants no authority.
